findings.title: Role route admitted trinity-system's key and an admin's user-scoped key
findings.description: require_admin alone admits mcp_scope in {None, user, system}; either key could promote any account to admin.
findings.exploit: A prompt-injected trinity-system or a leaked admin user-scoped key calls PUT /api/users/<any>/role {role: admin}.

findings.title: A demotion could be undone through the whitelist row's stale role
findings.description: A role change updated only users.role; the whitelist row kept the old role, which an account created for the address gets again after a re-bind.
findings.exploit: A demoted person re-binds the account to another mailbox and signs in with the old address as a new account at the old role.
findings.fix: db.set_whitelist_default_role on every successful role change; TestTheWhitelistRowFollowsTheRole, mutation-proved.
